product_metadata.title: SKL Home Mirage Fringe 100% Turkish Cotton Hand Towel Set, Aqua
description: The unsurpassed style of the Mirage Fringe hand towel will add luxury to your bathroom. The reversible, yarn dyed towel with woven jacquard medallion design is highlighted with a striped end hem and hand knotted fringe. Beautiful enough for guests but sturdy enough for every day use, the Mirage Fringe bath towel will be a delight in any bathroom. SKL Home by Saturday Knight Ltd. brings personality, fun and flair to the most intimate spaces in your home with products ranging from bath accessories and shower curtains, to towels, curtains and beyond. Whether your style is upbeat and modern, or classic and cozy, SKL Home provides a look to compliment almost any décor. Combining 40+ years’ experience, global design inspiration and premium fabrications, SKL Home continues to lead the way in home accessories.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash, Tumble dry low, Wash before using, Do not bleach
